item.title: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Season 1 Patch Notes
Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 was October's biggest game in the US, but it wasn't enough to crack 2026's best-selling top 10
item.description: Despite its somewhat muted critical reception, Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 has predictably topped the US video game charts in October. The Infinity Ward -developed shooter was October's best-selling game in the US across digital and retail, beating the month's other big-hitters, including Gears of War: E-Day and Star Wars: Galactic Racer. Read more

item.title: Modern Warfare 4 increased SBMM in DMZ despite multiplayer backlash: Report - Dexerto
item.description: Infinity Ward has reportedly tweaked Modern Warfare 4’s DMZ matchmaking to give player skill more weight when putting lobbies together.

item.title: Call of Duty Endowment marks Remembrance Day with veterans' Valor Pack push
item.description: The Call of Duty Endowment is marking Remembrance Day and its 17th anniversary by encouraging Modern Warfare 4 and Warzone players to pick up its Valor Pack, with all of Activision's net proceeds going towards helping veterans find jobs. Read more
